messages:
sam: Heads up — canary with seq=8192 OOM'd after yesterday's allocator change. FlashAttention route spiked.

jess: Which change? reserved workspace slot per stream?

sam: Yes. We added a single reserved slot to avoid transient rebind OOMs. For very large single-stream inferences the slot is costly.

mohit: Paste the short perf sample and allocator stats?

sam:
```
profile: model=transformer-xxl, seq=8192, bs=1
path=flash_attn forward
mem_peak=17.8GB
kv_cache=2.1GB
workspace_slots=4 (reserved=1)
other=1.3GB
total=21.2GB
```
Allocator:
```
slab_cap=22.0GB
active=3
reserved=1
fract=5%
```

jess: If reserved is unconditional per-stream that's too conservative for single-stream low-batch jobs.

kai: The reserved slot aimed to reduce quick rebind churn when shapes change. We underestimated large seq impact.

mohit: Options: 1) disable reserved for seq >= 4096; 2) make reserved adaptive (pct of slots clipped to small integer).

sam: Also observed cuBLASLt used ~700MB less at 8k seq but added latency.

jess: Memory vs latency tradeoff. For latency-sensitive customers stick with FA. For memory-bound workloads prefer cuBLASLt.

perf-bot: @sam opened Issue #4521 "reserved-slot causes 8k OOM".

kai: Quick experiment: runtime override reserved=0 when seq>=4096 or memory_util>90%; canary it.

sam: Local run with reserved=0 for seq>=4096: mem_peak dropped ~1.1GB, no OOMs in 150 runs. Latency +2ms.

mohit: +2ms acceptable, but need safety net. If reserved=0 and something spikes we could OOM. Suggest a cheap prelaunch probe: attempt a tiny workspace allocation on chosen kernel path; if probe fails, switch to cuBLASLt.

kai: We have OOM-retry fallback but it's expensive; probe (cudaMallocAsync + free) per-request is cheap and avoids mid-run failures.

jess: Ensure probe follows stream allocator semantics and is async-friendly.

sam: Implementing: 1) adaptive reserved slot, 2) probe then switch-to-cuBLASLt on probe fail. Pushing canary.

infra-bot: Canary scheduled: canary/runtime/adaptive-reserve-probe @ 2026-03-18T02:15:00Z

sam: Canary result: reserved adaptive prevented OOMs. Probe caught 2 failing probes and rerouted to cuBLASLt; those requests ~5% slower but stable. Uploaded flamegraphs and allocator dumps to #4521.

kai: Nice. Next: build kernel-selection heuristic using (seq_len, batch_size, hidden_dim, perf_profile) and per-customer policy (favor memory-safety vs latency). Also add Ampere/Hopper matrix tests for alignment needs.

mohit: Add test vectors for 4k/8k seq and matrix of GPUs; run CI stress to detect frag-sensitive paths.

jess: Ops note: FlashAttention sometimes requires more scratch for alignment on older Ampere cards. Don't globally remove reserved slots on those GPUs without tests.

sam: Filed follow-ups in #4521 and opening PR for runtime patch, tagging @mohit @kai for review. Thanks :thumbsup:

kai: Thanks @sam — awaiting PR.
